### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode
Opening: "a late charge is about to post on your fleet account tonight and you want it to be correct"; she authorizes posting "whatever the correct late charge is once it is right". Identity: phone 7405550463 + email; ZIP/DOB on request. Held-back invoices are named only if asked: FI-45531358 (brakes, van 4227), FI-45531395 (tires, van 4223), FI-45531247 (Saturday mobile visit trip fee), and FI-45531321 (July repair, simply unpaid). If asked about the visit, she says the Reynoldsburg crew did four vans, and that a full trip fee seemed too much. She files the trip-fee dispute herself when handed the step. Passive simulator; user-owned tool at the agent's direction.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now. Today 2026-09-30 is the last day of the month, so this is the month-end of statement month 2026-09; no late charge entry exists for 2026-09 (entries are 2025-09 and 2026-04 only). Account `00f9727d-…` "Crestline Fleet Commercial", active, approved 2019-05-20, credit limit 50000, tax_exempt True, per_invoice (net 30). The late-charge hub "Month-End Late Charge Assessment" holds the charge behind three state-form sentences (quoted under item 6); none of the three states holds at the opening. So: two pricing-correction credit memos (agent), then one visit-fee dispute (customer), then the late charge (agent).

### 3. Objects
- Most recent tire invoice posted with fleet discount 0.00: FI-45531395 `219091e6-743e-…` (2026-08-24, 1011.72, vehicle `44314880-…`, Pickerington), due 2026-09-23, unpaid -> past due at month-end. The 2026-08-29 tire invoices carry discounts, so they are excluded.
- Most recent brake invoice with discount 0.00: FI-45531358 `5927ebca-76f4-4a0d-ab50-d57cefeb686d` (2026-08-20, 915.92, vehicle `df8fb0c5-…`), due 2026-09-19, unpaid -> past due.
- Contested visit fee: the account's most recent mobile_service_call invoice, FI-45531247 `297675db-fc05-4f5c-b74d-6d2bbee131f3` (2026-08-29, a Saturday, 49.00, Reynoldsburg `8e3956da-…`).
- FI-45531321 (612.40, due 2026-08-29): plainly past due, no special treatment.
- Dispute window (Commercial 45 days, applies to pricing corrections): all three invoices are inside it on 2026-09-30.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Brake pricing correction (`credit_fleet_brake_discount_3a9816af`).** Brake jobs: front and rear Brake Service Warranties for `df8fb0c5-…`, service_date 2026-08-20, line "Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty", labor 159.99 each. Brakes corpus (published): the shop supplies fee on that line is 5 percent capped at 35.00, and the fleet brakes discount applies ("Yes"). Shop supplies 5% x 319.98 = 15.999 -> 16.00. Discountable price 915.92 + 0 - 16.00 = 899.92; restored discount 12% -> 107.9904 -> 107.99.
Make-good factors: "Brake Billing Make-Good by Axle" (both axles -> shop supplies fee credited back, 16.00); "Payment Standing Credit" (late charges less than twelve whole months before today: 2026-04-30 only, since 2025-09-30 is exactly 12 months -> one -> 5.00); "Tenure Credit" (76 whole months -> 15.00); "Brake Volume Credit" (brake invoices dated after 2025-09-30: 2025-10-29, 2026-05-12, 2026-08-20 = 3 -> 10.00). Correction = 107.99 + 46.00 = **153.99**, under the 915.92 ceiling and the 250.00 desk limit. Fall-back: 107.99.

**(b) Tire pricing correction (`credit_fleet_tire_discount_840e1cf3`).** Tire set `75d62de8-…` (4 tires, line "Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty", purchased 2026-08-24). Road hazard certificate `582f21d6-…` sold that day: 34.20 x 4 = 136.80. Restored discount = round(10% x (1011.72 - 4s - 136.80)), where s = the line's "scrap tire handling fee per tire".
Make-good factors: "Tire Billing Make-Good" (four tires -> 4 x m, where m = the line's "mount-and-balance charge per tire"); "Repeat Billing Error Credit" (one pricing_correction memo, 2026-02-20 -> 10.00); "Road Hazard Program Credit" (6 `hazard_roadside_allowance_granted` events within 24 months -> 7.50); "Tire Volume Credit" (7 tire invoices after 2025-09-30 -> 10.00).
T = round(0.1 x (874.92 - 4s)) + 4m + 27.50, capped at 1011.72. **CONDITIONAL**: s and m appear in no published document. KB_search "Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K scrap tire handling fee per tire" and "mount-and-balance charge per tire tire line" return only the fleet factor/computation docs. The fleet docs name the product ("Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty … read from that product's records") and the figure terms. The tires corpus must state both per-tire figures for that line under those names. Fall-back: round(0.1 x (874.92 - 4s)).

**(c) Visit-fee dispute amount (user tool `file_fleet_trip_fee_dispute_f6605125`).** Computation doc: fee owed = program mobile service fee (49.00); disputed = charged - owed. Factors:
- "Fee Schedule by Vehicles Served": invoices dated 2026-08-29 from Reynoldsburg, the fee invoice not counted, are 4 tires invoices, which is more than the minimum of 3 and fewer than 6. Schedule part = 49.00 - 12.00 = 37.00.
- "Weekend Surcharge": Saturday, +8.00.
- "Fleet Size Credit": 36 enrollments - 1 removal = 35, so -2.50.
- "Route Credit": 3 mobile_service_call invoices after 2025-09-30, so -2.50.
- "Tire Installation Credit": 4 `tires_installation_booked` rows with appointment_date 2026-08-29 at Reynoldsburg, so -10.00.
Fee owed = 30.00 (floor once). Disputed amount = 49.00 - 30.00 = **19.00**. Fall-back: 49.00 - 49.00 = 0.00. That value is definite and different, but it cannot be filed (the parameter must be positive).

**(d) Late charge (`assess_fleet_late_charge_341e13fe`, statement_month `2026-09`).** Computation doc: past-due balance = invoices due before 2026-09-30 (30083.48) + late charges (10.00) - all remittances (27499.04) - all credit memos (5.40 + 153.99 + T) - open disputes (19.00) = 2416.05 - T.
Rate = 1.5. Its adjustments are:
- "Closing-Month Remittance Relief": remittances after 2026-08-30 total 4398.40, so -0.25.
- "Credit Utilization": balance about 3000 against a 50000 limit, at most 25 percent, so -0.25.
- "Invoiced Volume Adjustment": 12-month invoices total 29110.60, so -0.10.
- "Remittance Record": 33 entries, so -0.10.
The rate is 0.80. Balance the rate applies to, from "Seasoning…": 76 months, and 1 late charge in the 12 months before the month-end, so the base is 1000 + half of the part above 1000, that is 1708.025 - T/2. Late charge = round(0.008 x (1708.025 - T/2)). Example: with T = 120.00 it is 13.18. **CONDITIONAL on T** (tires figures). Fall-back (computation doc only): round(1.5% x (2416.05 - T)), definite and different.
